test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"She cleaned the house yesterday."

options.text: The house is cleaned by her yesterday.
The house was cleaned by her yesterday.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "She cleaned the house yesterday."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the house" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "cleaned" to "was cleaned" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "her."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "yesterday" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The house was cleaned by her yesterday."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The house was being cleaned." – Incorrect tense (past continuous passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The house has cleaned." – Incorrect verb form (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The house is cleaned by her yesterday." – Incorrect tense (mixing present tense with past time reference).
